thread:
ana: FYI getting an influx of OIDC token exchange 401s from partner-apps around 11:03 UTC. errors shown: "invalid_client: JWT kid not found"

devon: which idp client? any recent JWKS publish or key rotation?

ana: client_id=partner-prod, our idp logs show `kid=kp_2026_03_12` in incoming assertion but JWKS served has kp_2026_03_11 and kp_old only.

rakesh: hmm ops pushed a jwks publish at 10:58 with rollback at 11:00 due to formatting. maybe clients cached the new kid. post the jwks endpoint response.

ana: jwks response snippet at 11:03:
```
{"keys":[{"kid":"kp_2026_03_11","kty":"RSA","n":".."},{"kid":"kp_old","kty":"RSA","n":".."}]}
```

devon: and token header shows kp_2026_03_12 so verification fails -> 401. ops-bot, did we run a partial key publish earlier?

ops-bot: publish-job job-id=pub-9ab started 2026-03-12T10:57:40Z -> status=FAILED (schema validation) -> rollback applied 2026-03-12T11:00:12Z.

ana: that explains mismatch. why did clients start using kp_2026_03_12 kid? partner said their OIDC client fetched new metadata at 10:59 and cached it.

rakesh: timeline: (1) generate new key kp_2026_03_12 -> (2) publish job attempted -> (3) client fetch succeeded before rollback -> (4) publish failed and rollback removed kp_2026_03_12 from JWKS -> validation breaks.

devon: mitigation options: (A) re-publish kp_2026_03_12 and fix schema, (B) temporarily accept tokens with kp_2026_03_12 by adding it to JWKS, (C) ask partner to re-fetch metadata (less reliable).

ana: option B fastest: add kp_2026_03_12 back to jwks endpoint while we fix schema then re-run publish properly.

rakesh: agree. I'm opening a high-priority key-restore task and will append kp_2026_03_12 to jwks cache. also adding a note to audit: publish-job pub-9ab failed causing auth regression.

alert-bot: Incident created: INC-20260312-oidc-kid-mismatch. severity=P2. paging oncall.

devon: separate but related: at 10:40 we saw SCIM provisioner hit throttling and queued many requests; some partner accounts in the same window show provisioning incomplete. Could be correlated load causing metadata fetch timing oddities.

ana: SCIM logs show 429s between 10:42-10:52 from scim-provisioner: `rate limit exceeded` and retry jitter spilled into 11:00s.

rakesh: suggests a cascade: scim retries increased load on infra, partners re-fetched metadata under backpressure, leading to partial updates. need to check KMS signing service too — any signing errors?

ana: KMS signing: a few `KMS.Sign` transient errors at 10:56: `DeadlineExceeded` in signing pool, likely due to increased QPS.

devon: ops, can we temporarily scale signing pool and replenish jwks cache from key store? avoid another failed publish.

ops-bot: scaling signing-pool from 4 -> 12 nodes. cache warmup triggered for jwks. estimated warm in 60s.

rakesh: added checklist: (1) restore kp_2026_03_12 to jwks cache; (2) re-run publish-job after schema fix in staging; (3) scale signing pool and throttle scim retries; (4) capture SSO and SCIM audit logs 10:30-11:10 for postmortem.

devon: will add RBAC note: an onboarding script that changed ServicePrincipal role for scim-provisioner at 09:58 reduced its concurrency limits. we're reverting that change — it should not have removed KMS signing permission, but check.

ana: confirmation: service account `scim-provisioner-sa` lost iam.role/kms.signer in that change; we restored it at 11:11. that explains some KMS errors pre-11:00.

rakesh: rolling update: jwks restored at 11:06, signing-pool scaled, scim retry rate capped. partner reported successful token exchange at 11:09.

devon: monitoring: token exchange error rate back to baseline, scim backlog draining. keep watch for 2 hours. create follow-up postmortem and include keys: kp_2026_03_12, pub-9ab, task ids: restore-77.

ana: for audit: please ensure CloudAudit exported logs include `iam.changes` and `kms.sign` events around 09:30-11:30. I see a gap in exports between 10:50-11:05.

rakesh: filing storage ticket — possible exporter hiccup during signing-pool scaling. ticket EX-5421.

devon: vuln check: kp_2026_03_12 generated with rsa2048 and padding PKCS1v1.5; recommend switch to RSA-PSS for new keys. add to remediation.

ana: summary for incident page: root cause = failed JWKS publish job pub-9ab combined with SCIM/backpressure and an unintended RBAC change that reduced signing capability; impact = partner OIDC token validation 401s and delayed provisioning; mitigations = key restore, scale signing pool, revert RBAC, throttle scim retries; next steps = publish fix, postmortem, update runbooks.

rakesh: adding runbook task to prevent immediate deletion of freshly published keys for 24h and require schema validation in staging before prod publish.

ana: thanks all. will update INC-20260312 with timeline and actions. closing channel in 2h if stable.
